description: Source code for a plugin that exports BORIS observations to a FERAL-compatible JSON format, including dialog classes for behavior selection and video categorization, and a run function that processes data and saves output.

classes.name: BehaviorSelectDialog
classes.description: Dialog for selecting which BORIS behavior codes to export as FERAL classes.

classes.name: CategoryDialog
classes.description: Dialog for organizing videos into categories for export splits.

methods.name: BehaviorSelectDialog.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the behavior selection dialog with behavior codes.

methods.name: BehaviorSelectDialog._select_all
methods.description: Selects all behavior codes in the list.

methods.name: BehaviorSelectDialog._select_none
methods.description: Deselects all behavior codes in the list.

methods.name: BehaviorSelectDialog.selected_codes
methods.description: Returns the list of selected behavior codes.

methods.name: CategoryDialog.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the category organization dialog with video items.

methods.name: CategoryDialog._make_column
methods.description: Creates a layout column with a label and widget.

methods.name: CategoryDialog._make_list_widget
methods.description: Creates and configures a QListWidget for drag-and-drop categorization.

methods.name: CategoryDialog._collect
methods.description: Collects and returns the list of videos in a category, stripping trailing '*' characters.

methods.name: CategoryDialog.categories
methods.description: Returns the current categorization of videos.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function to export BORIS observations to a FERAL JSON file, including behavior selection, video categorization, and data processing.
